additional_ownership.attachment_allocation: gpu_surface.rs SurfaceAttachments::ensure_guarded is the one default native MSAA attachment allocator; all four hosts prepare through it after surface admission and before scene preparation. Renderer::ensure_msaa reuses the preflight attachment. Other textures (glyph atlas, world resources, captures) are not surface attachment adoption.
additional_ownership.auxiliary_close: sync_global_preferences_window / sync_project_preferences_window / sync_new_project_window close coordinator host and drop owned surface; SurfaceTransaction::drop closes QueueOwner host accounting. Arc native windows are released when surface/window references drop.
additional_ownership.main_close: request_controlled_close performs terminal shutdown then event-loop exit; App/Runtime drop runs SurfaceTransaction::drop. Main native window is an existing static leaked reference; this audit does not claim main-window allocation teardown before process exit.
additional_ownership.device_replacement: Runtime::replace_native_gpu swaps SurfaceTransaction/Renderer/device; auxiliary replacement drops old surface owners; coordinator rebind rejects stale host/device receipts.
